projects.title: Web Crawler Using Java
projects.description:
This web crawler crawls the cse.uta.edu website and does the following:

Gets all links and recursively call the processPage method (BFS traversal)
Goes to only those links that have faculty and doesn't start with mailto: and length<150 and is not a pdf link. It ignores already visited link.
Stores unique traversed links in database and constructs an N-ary tree from the links traversed. Then diameter of the N-ary tree is calculated.
It does not crawl to the www.uta.edu as a requirement. www.uta.edu is the parent of cse.uta.edu
References:
http://techieme.in/tree-diameter/
http://programtalk.com/java/java-tree-implementation/
http://www.geeksforgeeks.org/diameter-n-ary-tree/
